design_status: Support-informed exploratory follow-up; not represented as a fully outcome-blind confirmatory design.
research_question: Did post-2022 RCEP supplier-link intensity change differentially with firms' frozen 2017-2019 exposure to previously separate China-Asia trade-agreement architectures?
theory: RCEP's common rules-of-origin and cumulation framework spans the prior ASEAN, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, and Japan architectures. A firm sourcing across more architectures had greater potential gains from institutional unification.
interpretation_limit: Architecture count is a readiness proxy, not observed certificate use, tariff utilization, or value-added cumulation.

sample.rule: Use the complete five-year panel with valid 2017-2019 frozen industry and average size created under Experiment 07; no new row or firm exclusion is permitted.

exposure.primary: Count from zero to five of ASEAN, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, and Japan supplier architectures active at least once in 2017-2019.
exposure.secondary: Indicator for two or more architectures.

outcomes.primary: asinh count of unique active RCEP supplier relationships.
secondary: asinh count of active RCEP supplier countries
RCEP share of active Asian supplier relationships

estimating_equations.dynamic: Y_it = alpha_i + lambda_industry-year + sum(year != 2021) gamma_year(ArchitectureCount_i x Year) + error_it
estimating_equations.static: Y_it = alpha_i + lambda_industry-year + beta(Post2022_t x ArchitectureCount_i) + error_it
estimating_equations.randomization_inference: 999 permutations of architecture count within frozen industry-by-size-tercile strata, seed 20260723; all draws retained.

support_replication_gate.requirements: Exactly reproduce the 2,556-firm candidate panel and its source hash; require at least 2,000 firms, 250 with one or more architectures, 40 with two or more, and 100 annual positive outcomes.
support_replication_gate.disclosure: These thresholds are support-informed and cannot serve as independent design validation.

identification_gate.pretrend: The 2020 ArchitectureCount interaction relative to 2021 has p >= 0.10.
identification_gate.economic_threshold: Absolute 2020 interaction <= 0.05 on the asinh-link scale per architecture.
identification_gate.limited_power: Only one non-overlapping pre-policy interaction is available; this limitation is mandatory in interpretation.
identification_gate.stop_rule: Failure stops before the static post interaction, permutations, secondary outcomes, robustness, mechanisms, or heterogeneity.

evidence_gate.positive_exploratory_result: Static interaction has stratified-randomization p < 0.05, same sign for the multi-architecture and active-country outcomes, and no single-industry sign reversal.
evidence_gate.inconclusive: Identification passes but the post interaction is ordinary under stratified assignments.
evidence_gate.integrity: No sample, threshold, exposure mapping, outcome, stratum, seed, or industry is changed after coefficient inspection.

amendment_rule: Any change after freeze is appended to pap/amendments.md before execution.
